slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.evidence_quote: If a 4-month contract is chosen, does it have to cover the full required area for all 4 months, or can it cover only part of the area with other contracts covering the rest?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about full-area coverage for a 4-month contract, which is related to contract coverage, but did not explicitly ask whether a signed contract must remain active for every month in its term.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether at least two different contract lengths must be signed or whether a single contract type is acceptable.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a maximum limit on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can the company rent more area than the required amount in any month, or must the total rented area in each month be exactly equal to the required area?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly rented area must exactly equal the required area, covering the no-shortage/no-excess requirement.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked for the optimization goal or confirmed that the objective is to minimize total rental cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to diversify contract lengths; any combination of contract lengths is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about contract-length diversity, so this business constraint remained unconfirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no cap on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts, so this operational limit remained unconfirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to minimize total rental cost.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly asked for or confirmed the optimization objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped after repeated demand-satisfaction questions without resolving the P0 objective slot H5 or the P1 contract-diversity slot H2.

summary: The agent confirmed exact demand satisfaction but failed to ask about the optimization objective, contract-length diversity, or the maximum number of distinct contracts, and then stopped prematurely after many repetitive questions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
